images.review: Personally viewed 900x800 image. Grey west stair-end wall and corridor slabs continuous; brick pods/cores and original green/dark windows preserved. Open courtyard and slab gaps retained, neutral broad roofs distinct. No text or new diagonal color fragments seen.

Personally viewed 900x800 image. Existing brick east wall/windows preserved. Different-material end grid stays neutral, real lower arch remains open; no invented glass or brick fill. Broad roof retained neutral; no new diagonal color fragments seen.

Personally viewed 900x800 elevation. Grey wing west walls and main corridor slabs continue across complete original components; brick cores/pods and open dark corridor spaces stay intact. Visible diagonal zigzags are original solid stair geometry, not a new painted triangular seam. True center arch remains open. No image text.

Personally viewed lower oblique source-angle image. Grey open-corridor slab/return surfaces read continuously without recoloring the dark backs as glass. Brick pod and tower family is preserved, and west thick stair proxies remain grey rather than green metal railings. No invented geometry, overpainted roof or text seen.

Personally viewed left side image. Existing outer wing brick/window family is unchanged, while west-end grey returns and corridor support surfaces connect cleanly. Different-material tall end grid remains neutral rather than falsely brick-filled. Roof round holes remain open and broad roof tops unchanged. No new diagonal color fragments or text.

Personally viewed opposite side image. Both sides preserve existing brick/window materials and neutral end grid. Grey slab continuity, original roof aperture and thick west stair family are consistent. Broad roofs and artificial base remain neutral, with no new color triangles or text.

Personally viewed full top image. Broad roofs, court/ground and artificial base remain neutral rather than falsely extended brick or green. Both original roof apertures, roof shelter gap and recessed court/stair outlines retained. Full model inside frame; no text. Grey inner aperture edge is subtle from this nearly vertical angle.

Personally viewed same-camera original front render alongside revised front. Overall geometry/framing, brick/green/dark surfaces and roof/base unchanged. Difference is a modest warm-neutral to existing grey-white shift on supported west end wall and corridor slab/return faces. No misleading camera or lighting change.

Personally viewed same-camera original rear render alongside revised rear. Brick rear/window system, neutral different-material end grid, roof and real arch unchanged. Supported grey changes are mostly obscured from this angle, so visual difference is correctly subtle; no invented extra rear detail or changed lighting/framing.
